title: Garwan Law Chamber: Modernizing Legal Intake & Attorney Portals
formulaSummary: An authoritative digital legal practice portal built with React 19, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL for Garwan Law Chamber, achieving an 85% reduction in initial consultation administrative scheduling time, sub-second load times, and confidential upfront case brief management.

problem.heading: Unstructured Case Inquiries & Manual Advocate Coordination
problem.description: Garwan Law Chamber handled high-stakes civil and corporate inquiries primarily through informal messaging and walk-ins. Prospective clients lacked a unified platform to review practice credentials, verify attorney jurisdictions, and submit confidential case briefs. Administrative staff spent hours daily sorting unvetted inquiries and coordinating lawyer schedules manually.
painPoints: Prospective litigants submitted incomplete case details, wasting senior attorney consultation time
Staff manually coordinated schedules across multiple advocates via phone and messaging
No centralized digital directory showcasing practice area expertise and jurisdictional credentials
International and corporate clients lacked a seamless consultation scheduling channel

solution.heading: Structured Case Intake & Advocate Consultation Management
solution.description: Tech Agenz designed and engineered a bespoke, secure legal technology portal tailored to the chamber's practice hierarchy. The platform incorporates structured case intake forms with preliminary fact gathering, automated appointment booking synced to advocate calendars, and authoritative practice directories that present credentials with institutional prestige. Deployed on modern server-rendered infrastructure with sub-second page loads and strict privacy protocols.
keyDeliverables: Structured digital intake questionnaires capturing jurisdiction and essential facts prior to meetings
Advocate consultation booking synced to attorney calendars to eliminate scheduling conflicts
Authoritative practice directory outlining Corporate, Civil, Constitutional, and Appellate practice areas
High-performance responsive portal with sub-second page loads and strict privacy protection

architecture.overview: Server-rendered architecture built with React 19, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. Client inquiry payloads are validated, structured, and securely delivered to the chamber's administrative portal with calendar synchronization.
